interruption.cause: Unknown external process termination; no live scorer/controller and no completed grader result; not enough evidence to identify the killer
interruption.recovery: Operator-audited once-only scoring of the identical sealed patch; original empty incomplete directory retained

earliest_verified_break: PLANNING: an initialization/launch contract was treated as readiness; a later test binding substituted for an establishment mechanism

supporting_source.fact: Run initializes an empty aggregation map and enters subscription consumption; an asynchronous caller has no completion guarantee from launch alone

failure_plan_claim: Run's initialization is the evidenced readiness contract for the new dispatcher.

failure_patch.behavior: Publishes the replacement and launches it before stopping the old object; no readiness barrier

later_failure: Re-diagnosis identifies empty-state/replay correctly, but planning stops with NEEDS_EVIDENCE because no existing readiness primitive is shown; adding a justified local primitive must remain an allowed repair strategy

checks: Source quote binds delivered same-snapshot hash-checked excerpt
Planned establishment cites actual change IDs
Requirement persists through correction/READY and execution
Read-only queue inspection distinguishes abandoned RUNNING
not_proven: A source quote alone does not prove the asserted semantics
A valid plan does not prove the patch implements it
One real success does not establish stability
